meta.name: saas-landing-gen
meta.description: Generate a complete SaaS landing page with EdgeOne Pages deployment. Includes hero section, features, pricing, testimonials, and CTA sections. Supports React + Tailwind CSS, one-command deploy to EdgeOne Pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键生成 SaaS 落地页并部署上线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并部署一个 SaaS 产品官网。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and deploy a SaaS landing page with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly build and deploy a SaaS product website.

howto.what: 生成一个完整的 SaaS 落地页（包含导航、英雄区、功能、定价、客户评价、行动号召和页脚），并自动部署到 EdgeOne Pages，返回托管 URL 和源代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“帮我做一个 SaaS 落地页”、“generate a saas landing page”等触发词时，或要求创建软件产品官网时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 SaaS 落地页，产品叫“智联”，标语是“连接未来”。
say.note: Claude 会询问更多细节并生成页面。

say.text: 生成一个 SaaS 落地页，功能包括：数据分析、团队协作、实时报告。
say.note: Claude 会使用这些功能生成 Features 部分。

howto.what_en: Generates a complete SaaS landing page (including navbar, hero, features, pricing, testimonials, CTA, and footer) and deploys it to EdgeOne Pages, returning a hosted URL and full source code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like '帮我做一个 SaaS 落地页', 'generate a saas landing page', or ask to create a software product website.

say_en.text: Create a SaaS landing page for 'SmartLink' with tagline 'Connecting the future'.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for more details and generate the page.

say_en.text: Generate a SaaS landing page with features: data analytics, team collaboration, real-time reports.
say_en.note: Claude will use these features for the Features section.
